# 0xRPC
> 0xRPC provides blockchain RPC infrastructure, APIs, and developer tooling for accessing EVM-compatible networks.

0xRPC offers RPC endpoints, chain support information, and developer resources for building applications that interact with multiple blockchain networks.

## Documentation
- [Docs Home](https://0xrpc.io/docs): Main documentation hub for getting started with 0xRPC services.
- [Getting Started](https://0xrpc.io/docs/getting-started): Introductory guide for connecting applications to 0xRPC endpoints.
- [Authentication](https://0xrpc.io/docs/authentication): Explains API key usage and request authentication requirements.
- [Rate Limits](https://0xrpc.io/docs/rate-limits): Describes throughput limits, quotas, and usage constraints.
- [Error Codes](https://0xrpc.io/docs/error-codes): Reference for common API and RPC error responses.
- [FAQ](https://0xrpc.io/docs/faq): Answers to common questions about setup, usage, and support.

## RPC API Reference
- [RPC Overview](https://0xrpc.io/docs/rpc): Overview of supported JSON-RPC methods and endpoint behavior.
- [Ethereum Methods](https://0xrpc.io/docs/rpc/ethereum): Reference for Ethereum-compatible JSON-RPC method support.
- [Network Endpoints](https://0xrpc.io/docs/rpc/endpoints): Lists available RPC endpoints and network-specific URLs.
- [WebSocket Support](https://0xrpc.io/docs/rpc/websocket): Details WebSocket connectivity and subscription capabilities.
- [Batch Requests](https://0xrpc.io/docs/rpc/batch-requests): Explains sending multiple JSON-RPC calls in a single request.
- [Tracing Methods](https://0xrpc.io/docs/rpc/tracing): Documents tracing and debug RPC methods where available.

## Supported Networks
- [Networks Overview](https://0xrpc.io/docs/networks): Summary of chains and environments supported by 0xRPC.
- [Ethereum](https://0xrpc.io/docs/networks/ethereum): Network details, chain IDs, and endpoint information for Ethereum.
- [Polygon](https://0xrpc.io/docs/networks/polygon): Network details, chain IDs, and endpoint information for Polygon.
- [Arbitrum](https://0xrpc.io/docs/networks/arbitrum): Network details, chain IDs, and endpoint information for Arbitrum.
- [Optimism](https://0xrpc.io/docs/networks/optimism): Network details, chain IDs, and endpoint information for Optimism.
- [Base](https://0xrpc.io/docs/networks/base): Network details, chain IDs, and endpoint information for Base.
- [BNB Chain](https://0xrpc.io/docs/networks/bnb-chain): Network details, chain IDs, and endpoint information for BNB Chain.

## Guides
- [Guides Home](https://0xrpc.io/docs/guides): Collection of practical integration and usage tutorials.
- [Connect with ethers.js](https://0xrpc.io/docs/guides/ethersjs): Shows how to use 0xRPC with ethers.js providers.
- [Connect with web3.js](https://0xrpc.io/docs/guides/web3js): Shows how to use 0xRPC with web3.js clients.
- [Using viem](https://0xrpc.io/docs/guides/viem): Demonstrates viem configuration with 0xRPC endpoints.
- [Switching Networks](https://0xrpc.io/docs/guides/switching-networks): Explains multi-chain configuration and network selection patterns.
- [WebSocket Subscriptions](https://0xrpc.io/docs/guides/websocket-subscriptions): Guide to listening for events and new blocks over WebSockets.
- [Troubleshooting Requests](https://0xrpc.io/docs/guides/troubleshooting): Helps diagnose connectivity, timeout, and RPC response issues.

## Account and Usage
- [Dashboard](https://0xrpc.io/dashboard): Account dashboard for managing projects, keys, and usage.
- [Projects](https://0xrpc.io/dashboard/projects): Manage application projects and associated RPC credentials.
- [API Keys](https://0xrpc.io/dashboard/api-keys): Create, rotate, and revoke API keys for authenticated access.
- [Usage Metrics](https://0xrpc.io/dashboard/usage): View request volume, consumption, and service activity.
- [Billing](https://0xrpc.io/dashboard/billing): Manage plans, invoices, and payment-related account settings.
- [Team Settings](https://0xrpc.io/dashboard/team): Configure team access and shared workspace permissions.

## Status and Support
- [Status Page](https://0xrpc.io/status): Service health, uptime, and incident reporting for 0xRPC systems.
- [Support](https://0xrpc.io/support): Contact and support entry point for technical or account issues.
- [Contact](https://0xrpc.io/contact): General contact page for sales, partnerships, and inquiries.
- [Community](https://0xrpc.io/community): Community channels and developer discussion resources.

## Company
- [Home](https://0xrpc.io/): Main product homepage for 0xRPC infrastructure services.

- [Pricing](https://0xrpc.io/pricing): Plan and pricing information for RPC infrastructure access.
- [Blog](https://0xrpc.io/blog): Articles, announcements, and technical updates from the 0xRPC team.
- [Careers](https://0xrpc.io/careers): Open roles and hiring information for the company.
